basis: Familial atrial fibrillation is a cardiac rhythm disorder; reported associated findings are also cardiovascular.
Inherited amino acid transport disorder causing severe epileptic encephalopathy; nephrocalcinosis is a separately coded condition.
Fibrosis and emphysema directly damage lung tissue; associated pulmonary hypertension is a separate disease.
Eosinophilic immune disorder defined by recurrent cutaneous angioedema; the definition explicitly excludes typical visceral organ damage.
Spastic paraplegia and dystonia define neurologic disease; skeletal muscle wasting is a defining amyotrophic feature, although frequency is unspecified.
Corticospinal degeneration defines the disease; pes cavus and thenar atrophy occur in 80–99%, with other muscle wasting in 30–79%.
Isolated inherited hair-shaft disorder; abnormal hair texture and growth are reported in all patients.
Necrosis directly affects the exocrine pancreas; additional organ injury is variable and does not establish a common additional axis.
Trochlear nerve neuropathy; impaired eye movement reflects nerve dysfunction rather than direct ocular tissue damage.
Protozoal infection located in the small intestine.
The defining syndrome combines intellectual disability and microcephaly with phalangeal skeletal abnormalities; no other organ damage is established.
RTEL1 telomere disorder with marrow failure and immunodeficiency; cerebellar hypoplasia and developmental delay occur in 80–99%. Nail and GI findings are occasional.
IgE-mediated immediate hypersensitivity; asthma, eczema and allergic rhinitis are separately diagnosed diseases rather than universal organ damage.
Bone fragility, fractures, bowing and vertebral collapse define the disease; blue sclerae alone do not establish ocular dysfunction.
Carcinoma originates in the laryngeal vocal fold; the larynx belongs to the airway axis.
Localized malignant mesothelioma originates in the pleura.
Neoplasm of the nasal cavity, an upper airway site; lymphoma is only one subtype of this umbrella concept.
Fungal infection directly inflames the meninges of the central nervous system.
Defective airway clearance causes bronchiectasis; recurrent middle-ear inflammation occurs in 15/16 patients. Cardiac defects are minority findings.
Sweat-gland salt transport disorder; direct electrolyte loss causes hypernatremic dehydration in 5/7 patients.
Benign ovarian epithelial neoplasm; reproductive tissue is outside the axes, with no endocrine dysfunction described.
EBV-driven proliferation of B, T or NK lymphocytes; extranodal sites vary across this broad disease group.
Developmental brain malformations, seizures and spasticity define the disorder; optic atrophy occurs in 2/3. Overlapping toes alone do not establish functional damage.
Localized necrosis of breast adipose tissue; breast disorders are explicitly outside the axes.
Inherited retinal degeneration caused by biallelic LCA5 variants; no extraocular disease is established.
